input.quote: (k) REPRESENTATION BY COUNSEL. Each party acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to be represented by separate independent counsel in the negotiation of this Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance obligation on Licensor. The only reference to "insurance" (p0051) is a Licensee cost-allocation for taxes, duties and shipping, not a coverage requirement, and the General Provisions (p0144-p0159) run from governing law through representation by counsel with no insurance sub-section. Licensor supplies and operates the Licensed Technology through which Licensee receives consolidated market data and transmits orders and trading tickets (p0007, p0021, p0031, p0033), so it is a hosting/services vendor touching our transaction data; the playbook's walk-away is no insurance for such a vendor. Inserted the model clause at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request) as new General Provision (l); fallback of E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance provision in General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard insurance provision, as our playbook requires vendors that host our platform and process our transaction and order data to carry CGL, E&O and cyber cover. If the cyber limit is an issue we can discuss E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence and US$2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than US$2,000,000; cyber liability and privacy insurance of not less than US$5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide Licensee with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
